title: Hello, Flag!
description: Welcome to CYBERFLAGS! This is your very first challenge. The flag is hidden in plain sight. Sometimes the answer is simpler than you think. Just read carefully and try the most obvious answer.
author: CyberFlags Team
hints: Read the challenge description very carefully!

title: Base64 Basics
description: We intercepted this encoded message from a suspicious source. Can you decode it? The encoded string is: ZmxhZ3tiYXM2NF9pc19ub3RfZW5jcnlwdGlvbn0=
author: CryptoMaster
hints: Use a Base64 decoder — there are many online tools

title: Inspect Element
description: A secret message is hidden somewhere in the challenge webpage. Can you find the hidden flag? Open the challenge site and use your browser's developer tools to dig around. Not everything is visible on the surface...
author: WebHacker
hints: Check the HTML comments and hidden elements

title: Caesar's Secret
description: Julius Caesar used a simple cipher to communicate with his generals. We found this encoded message: "iodj{fdhvdu_flskhu_lv_hdvb}". Can you crack the code and recover the original flag?
author: CryptoMaster
hints: This is a Caesar cipher with a shift of 3
Each letter is shifted forward by 3 positions in the alphabet

title: Binary Brain Teaser
author: BinWiz
hints: Each 8-digit group is one ASCII character

title: Packet Sniffer
description: We captured some suspicious network traffic. Hidden within the packet capture file is a secret flag. Download the PCAP file and analyze it with Wireshark or a similar tool. Look for unusual HTTP requests or hidden data in the TCP streams.
author: NetDetective
hints: Use Wireshark to open the file
